d: Reno stirs up more than memories when he heads back to the location of his rookie beat to search for a reluctant gangbanger wanted for murder.
Reno tracks Hound Adams, the only man who can clear Reno's name, to a Carlsbad sports bar.
Reno's surprise reunion with Leeza Bendetti at Bobby's scenic Duck Lake cabin is soured when he stumbles upon a trio of drug dealers.
Reno and Bobby travel to the tiny town in New Mexico, on the trail of a bail-jumper  to find him being hunted down by a posse for murder.
Cheyenne convinces a reluctant Bobby to post bail and help prove the innocence of her unrequited love  who has been arrested for the murder of his wife, Marily
Reno stumbles into a man-hunt for  brothers wanted for armed robbery and the confrontation results in the shooting death of the local sheriff.
Bobby and a reluctant Reno head to San Francisco when Bobby is contacted by a Import/Export magnate to find alleged Industrial spy Rikki Yeager.
After Reno saves Rikki Yeager from a psychotic bounty hunter.
When Reno walks into a museum robbery in progress while meeting with Judge Sarah Jessup, both he and the judge are 'introduced' to disillusioned Special Investigations cop.
Reno's freedom appears within reach when he goes after his nemesis Lt. Dutch Dixon who is wanted for the murder of his own partner.
When Reno stands trial for the murder of Buzzy Burrell, his quest for justice is complicated by Lt. Dutch Dixon who plans to insure that Reno never makes it to court alive.
As Reno waits out his pending appeal for murder, he is transfered to Paso Perdido Penitentiary where he finds himself in danger from the prison population as well as the law.
When Reno is saved during a bar fight by a man strongly resembling Elvis Presley, he attempts to track down 'the King' to express his thanks as well as satisfy his curiosity.
Reno goes to the aid of his Karate Master when one of the master's former pupils attacks a San Francisco councilwoman.

st: Way Down Yonder In New Orleans
d: When Reno goes to New Orleans after cold-blooded murderer, he finds himself the recipient of a 'dead man's curse'.
Reno saddles up to help when a friend of Bobby's is injured after uncovering a group of cattle rustlers operating through a traveling rodeo.
Reno and Cheyenne must pump themselves up when they go after a former weight lifter turned drug dealer
Reno finds himself an unwilling celebrity while in San Diego tracking a 'rave' party coordinator who is responsible for the near death of a teenage party goer.
Reno finds himself as prey in the middle of a dangerous 'hunt' after he and Bobby meet up with a former protege of Sixkiller Enterprises.
